intent_and_evidence: Application code depends on the ForecastProvider abstraction; the infrastructure adapter implements forecast generation and is supplied to the EMS context.
Portfolio services call a domain-facing repository contract while the concrete adapter owns in-memory persistence behavior.
The repository collaboration centralizes portfolio add/get/delete operations and keeps persistence details out of the application service.
